title: Model routing overlay
description: One layer above the catalog. Every field is optional: an overlay changes what it names and leaves the rest of the layer below it untouched. The host names the layers and their order (src/host.ts routingPaths).

note.description: Free text for whoever opens the file next. The mechanism never reads it.

weights.description: Strategy weights in percent. A named strategy is replaced whole, not merged field by field: a half-replaced weight set would silently stop summing to 100.

unknownAvailability.description: Points subtracted from a candidate whose availability is unknown, on top of counting its remaining limit as a neutral 50 per cent.

liveParticipantPerHarness.description: Points subtracted per participant already live on that harness.

liveParticipantCap.description: Ceiling for the sum of the above. Without it a busy harness would be unreachable rather than expensive.

reviewerDiversity.description: Points added to a reviewer candidate whose harness or model differs from the worker's.

reviewerQualityFloor.description: Lowest quality rating a reviewer candidate should have. A soft floor: if nothing reaches it, the best remaining candidate is chosen with a warning.

allow.description: Allow-lists. A non-empty list means: only these. An empty list is a shape error, not 'allow nothing' — write a deny rule for that.

deny.description: Deny-lists, applied after allow. A name in both is the contradiction models validate refuses.

ratings.description: Rating overrides by tuple id. Only the named ratings are replaced.

priority.description: Canonical-priority overrides by tuple id. Lower comes first.

allow.description: Whether pay-as-you-go tuples take part in automatic selection without the --allow-payg flag.

weight.description: Percent. The four of a set sum to 100; the sum is checked by models validate, not by this schema.

examples.note: schema example: a deny rule, a weight change, and a PAYG opt-in
